C0904.title: Inside the Black Market Behind Rampant Game Cheats
C0904.summary: In 2018, a major 'battle royale' cheat case supervised by China's Ministry of Public Security was cracked, resulting in 15 arrests and involving over 30 million yuan. The report reveals that cheat developers often collaborate with Trojan creators to embed malware in game hacks, aiming to steal account credentials and virtual assets from players who use the cheats.
